Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 31.08.2022 has moved this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No.19 of 2022 registered under Sections 419/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471/ 120(B)/ 109/ 413/ 414/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B)/ 66(C)/ 66(D) of the I.T. Act.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that as per the FIR, the brother of the petitioner,
namely, Akhilesh Verma was involved in cyber crime for which raid was conducted by the Police and two mobile sets were seized from the house.
The petitioner has been roped in the case only because from the house mobile was allegedly seized by this petitioner.
There is no material against whatsoever and he has been in custody since 31.08.2022.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the bail application is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below.
